name: smwgraphics-popful-mail-snes-lucina-temple
title: Popful Mail (SNES) - Lucina Temple
description:
The background seen in a special cutscene of Popful Mail for the Super Famicom. I have been playing this game for a while and it is such a small gem from the Super Famicom. Unfortunately, I don't know japanese, so the names I'm getting are mostly from the soundtrack. Possibly related to some kind of important figure or to a goddess. A great fit for castles or ruins, in general.

Credit would be great, but is optional.
